terraform.description: All .tf files in this repo are documentation examples (partials), not real infrastructure

packageRules.description: Internal loft-sh actions are referenced by their major tag (ci-test-notify/v1, docs-backport-action v1). We control those tags: repointing one updates every caller, and moving to v2 is a deliberate manual edit. Renovate must not pin or bump them
npm gets a longer stabilization window (more yanked/compromised releases)
Docusaurus packages must move in lockstep
Keep WebdriverIO and its assertion library together across major and minor updates to satisfy peer dependencies

Hold WebdriverIO majors until @wdio/browserstack-service ships a release that accepts the new @wdio/cli major. As of 9.40.1 it only accepts @wdio/cli ^9, so a v10 group update fails npm install with ERESOLVE (see #2894). Minor and patch updates still flow
Kubernetes Go deps must move in lockstep

loft-sh/api and loft-sh/agentapi pins track released platform versions and are bumped by the handle-source-release.yml automation; Renovate updates would conflict with the docs-sync pipeline. loft-sh/external-types follows the version loft-sh/api requires, which go mod tidy raises during an api bump. Bumping it alone can remove types the pinned api still uses and break the platform generator (see #2778)
invopop/jsonschema is pinned to the loft-sh fork via a replace directive: managed manually
Node.js is pinned in .nvmrc, netlify.toml, and the devcontainer image: bump them together
Keep internal actions on rolling tags

customManagers.description: Node.js version in the netlify.toml build environment (must match .nvmrc)
